responsibility: Implements the post-reload compare-elimination pass for targets whose arithmetic or move instructions clobber flags and therefore cannot rely on pre-reload combine for compare folding. It finds split compare instructions that set the target flags register, records a bounded set of their uses, checks whether the immediately preceding flags-clobbering arithmetic can be rewritten into a combined arithmetic-plus-compare PARALLEL with an appropriate CC mode, and if valid deletes the standalone compare; this target-driven optimization is exposed as the "cmpelim" RTL pass.
